purpose: 仅取得发现的外汇局实际官方入口并核发布时间及真实附件链接
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import requests,json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_safe_client_fx_cause_source_qualification_v1'
URL='https://www.safe.gov.cn/safe/2023/0215/22329.html'
def sha(blob):return hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
def save(path,obj):
 if path.exists():raise RuntimeError('拒绝覆盖原件或回执')
 path.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
save(OUT/'官方入口原请求清单.json',{'url':URL,'route_type':'OFFICIAL_CATALOG_ACTUAL_SEARCH_LINK','attempts':1,'registered_before_request':True})
record={'id':'S01','url':URL,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'attempts':1}
try:
 with requests.Session() as session:
  resp=session.get(URL,timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 historical research'})
  chunks=[];size=0
  for part in resp.iter_content(65536):
   size+=len(part)
   if size>20971520:raise RuntimeError('原件超过冻结单件上限')
   chunks.append(part)
  blob=b''.join(chunks)
  raw=OUT/'sources/银行结售汇官方入口.html'
  assert not raw.exists();raw.write_bytes(blob)
  record.update({'status_code':resp.status_code,'final_url':resp.url,'response_headers':dict(resp.headers),
   'raw_path':raw.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(blob),'bytes':len(blob)})
  soup=BeautifulSoup(blob.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),'lxml')
  for tag in soup(['script','style','noscript']):tag.decompose()
  body=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  text=OUT/'sources/银行结售汇官方入口.txt'
  text.write_text(body+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
  record.update({'title':soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None,
   'page_display_publication_dates':re.findall(r'发布日期[：:\\s]*([12][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})',body),
   'text_path':text.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
  links=[]
  for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
   label=a.get_text(' ',strip=True);href=urljoin(resp.url,a['href'])
   if any(key in label for key in ['银行结售汇','结售汇数据','时间序列','统计制度']) or re.search(r'\.(xls|xlsx|csv|pdf)(?:\?|$)',href,re.I):
    links.append({'label':label,'url':href})
  record['target_actual_links']=links
except Exception as error:record['request_error']=str(error)
record['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
save(OUT/'官方入口原响应.json',record)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k in ['status_code','title','bytes','request_error','page_display_publication_dates','target_actual_links']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
